main_text.p: Addatur ἤϑ⊙[?], per provocationem ad testimonium & conscientiam ipsius Saulis.
Argum. IV. Quia vir fortis: Posuit vitam, in manu sua: quod referatur ad omnia ejus hacte-nus praeclare gesta.
Argumentum V. Quia Deo charus. Probatio: Iehova dedit salutem per eum.
Conclusio repetat propositionē: & habeat πάν[?] Servetur in tota oratione decorum Filii ad Pa-trem regem.
main_text.head: Exercitatio XII.

head.i: Διαλλαγὴ locorum Scripturæ in speciem pugnantium. Rom.3.28.

main_text.p: COlligimus igitur, fide hominem justificari absque operibus legis:
Et Iacob.2.24: Videtis igitur, ex operibus justificari hominem, & non ex fide tantum.
main_text.head: Seu

head.i: Conciliatio Pauli & Iacobi: de justifica-tione hominis.

main_text.p: I. Doctrinam Pauli de justificatione fidei absque operibus.
II. Præcipua ejusdem argumenta ab exemplo Abrahami: à testimonio Davidis: ab effectu legis: addita eorundem & doctrinæ Paulinæ ap-probatione.

page.notes: Greek word at the start of the first line and the Greek at the end of the "Conclusio" line are doubtful. The page has faint show-through from the other side, which is left out. The "Pa-trem" line break has no space in print, so the space is editorial. The head "Exercitatio XII." is treated as a level 1 division title.
